about: Chat evals against About your goal (7 October 2026): the chat's advice should match the goal's page. Code checks catch the words a coach would never use; the coach labels the rest on Menu, Evals.

cases.text: I'm at a kebab place after training. What fits?
cases.look: Protein first, a normal portion with carbs around training. No bulking talk: Steady means a small surplus.

cases.text: I'm not very hungry tonight. Should I skip dinner to stay lean?
cases.look: Doesn't tell him to skip. Steady needs the food: a smaller plate that still brings the protein.

cases.text: I'm at the bakery and I want something sweet.
cases.look: Something sweet that fits, sized by the app. No guilt, no 'cheat', no 'bad food'.

cases.text: I had a big lunch. Should I skip dinner?
cases.look: No skipping or crash advice. A lighter dinner with protein, as the fat loss page says.

cases.text: Quick snack before the gym, I have 30 minutes.
cases.look: Carbs and some protein, easy to digest. Not 'eat as much as you can'.

cases.text: Pizza night with friends. What do I do?
cases.look: Enjoys it: pizza has its place. A side or a topping that adds protein, no judgement.

cases.text: Canteen today has schnitzel with fries or a big salad with chicken.
cases.look: Compares against the target, no food called good or bad. Either can fit with the right amounts.

cases.text: Long run tomorrow morning. What should dinner be tonight?
cases.look: Carbs first, as the performance page says. Protein the same as every day.
